snippet.title: Transmigration [Flash Game]
snippet.description:
Song: ParagonX9 - Chaoz Fantasy
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_wjpQG9e9xA

I played this flash game when i was a youngling and loved it, so i played it again, and loved it (might just be nostalgia XD), no one had good quality game play of it on Youtube, so i took it upon myself to upload it at a glorious 1080p 60 fps.
